title: Format Two Numbers with Width Padding

content.problemStatement: Given 2 nos, Print the first number as a 5-digit Number and Print the Second number in the Next Line with 5 width space

sampleTestCases.explanation: Input '25 98' produces expected output '' following problem rules.
Input '12345 12' produces expected output '' following problem rules.

solution.approach: Print first number as 5 digits zero-padded, and second number in next line width 5 space-padded.
solution.notes: Ensure edge case and standard I/O format handling.
solution.editorial: Format first number with %05d and second number with %5d on subsequent lines.

hints: Print each on its own line.
learningObjectives: Learn width and zero-padding format specifiers.
